game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway, a vine-choked archway: the rune scholar must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Matrix Map: Navigate a list of lists as rows and columns of a map.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway: a vine-choked archway
core_gameplay_loop: In Overgrown Archway, repeat each round: Navigate a list of lists as rows and columns of a map. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the map_cells value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about map_cells to power up the rune scholar and open the rune gate.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Matrix Map
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Matrix Map' (Week 7 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Overgrown Archway'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how map_cells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Overgrown Archway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
